newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann unit sells stake to Mitsui & Co.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann unit sells stake to Mitsui & Co.

text.p: German entertainment conglomerate Bertelsmann AG said on Monday leading Japanese trading company Mitsui & Co would buy a 35 percent stake in Bertelsmann's interactive media unit.
Mitsui will help distribute and develop CD-ROMs, online services and other multimedia products for Asian markets, a spokeswoman for Bertelsmann's T1 New Media GmbH said.
The companies plan to announce the partnership on Tuesday, but terms of the deal will not be disclosed, she said.
The privately held Bertelsmann has shown interest recently in equity partnerships with outside investors, but it denied the Mitusi agreement indicated a shift in that direction.
"When a joint venture with Mitsui happens, it will have nothing to do with finance. It will be for know-how," Bertelsmann spokesman Helmuth Runde said on Monday.
